title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.115
exact_target: If n cosets fail to cover a finite group, is at least a fraction two-to-the-minus-n of the group left uncovered?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2624 (KOU-21.115). CC BY 4.0.

B. Sambale, Problem 21.115, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). This version records an affirmative answer; the displayed question is the historically registered target.
